project_type: Monorepo streaming app - React web (Vite + Tailwind), React Native mobile (Expo 52), Bun server with TMDB API
build_system: Bun workspaces - each app has own package.json
test_framework: Vitest for web, ESLint for both web and mobile
verification_instructions: Run lint and build for web app. Mobile uses expo lint.
setup_instructions: cd apps/web && bun install; cd apps/mobile && bun install
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: fetchWithCache for API calls, ContentRail for horizontal lists, useQuery from @tanstack/react-query for data fetching
key_patterns: Server: Bun.serve with route matching via regex, fetchTMDB helper, transformers for list/detail items, cache with TTL. Web: lazy-loaded routes in App.jsx, Layout with NavLink, ContentRail for horizontal scrolling sections, DetailHero for item details, VideoPlayer for embedded iframe. Mobile: Expo Router tabs, same api.js pattern as web but with AsyncStorage cache.
directory_structure: apps/server/src/index.js (Bun API server), apps/web/src/ (React Vite app with app/ pages, components/, utils/), apps/mobile/src/ (Expo app with app/(tabs)/ for tabs, app/movie/ and app/tv/ for details, components/, utils/)
